limitations: Single-capture discovery results, not statistical repeat qualification.
Do not attribute small changes on inactive paths to this sparse representation.
Boundary collision snapshots plus retained warnings are not a lifetime no-drop certificate.
Zero factor status is observed at two metadata boundaries, not continuously recorded.
Equal seeds do not guarantee identical trajectories or contact counts.
Main and sensor graph spans are separate scopes; inclusive FPS already covers all environment work.
External asset content is not fully pinned by the Lab commit; documented Franka cache variant differs from older historical captures.
Cassie full endpoint support is derived from its cached USD topology, not directly logged runtime support.
